about: GTA 6 Trailer 2 (Rockstar Games, May 6, 2025) opens on Jason Duval up on a roof; a man below asks "What are you doing up there?" and Jason says "Just fixing some leaks." (heard in the trailer). Context: on September 19, 2022 Rockstar confirmed a network intrusion that leaked early development footage of the next Grand Theft Auto (about 90 videos, per reporting); on December 4, 2023 Rockstar posted "Our trailer has leaked" hours before Trailer 1's premiere. Rockstar never said the line is about the leaks: labeled THEORY. Trailer mode: two muted Trailer 2 excerpts (the opening house shot and the roof shot, where the line is spoken at 11.8-12.9 s of Rockstar's post), annotated. Delta.
